faqs.q: Can I have both in one visit?
faqs.a: Yes. Abhyanga followed by Shirodhara is 105 minutes for $230.
Clients commonly choose Shirodhara for sleep; the evidence is small studies, not trials.
Abhyanga is massage therapy by our RMT and is receipted; Shirodhara is not.
